property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and calls setOwner(newOwner), the call succeeds (does not revert) and returns true in the reference; the mutant changes the observable return value for successful calls (returns false), so the property that setOwner returns true for successful owner calls is violated by the mutant for some inputs.
change_summary: Make the function return false instead of true while still assigning owner — changes observable return value for successful calls.
